proxy, inherited and foreign-realm empty tokens cannot forge private authority
valid-looking copied canonical facts cannot replace an opaque validated handle

shared arrays are allowed but a cross-object cycle is rejected
negative zero and metadata revision stay distinct after populated cache
both donor and prior post-write populations survive alternating replacement cache entries
